assertion_results.text: Bug parsing extracts the Environment / Version section content including the vague text (Step 1)
assertion_results.evidence: bug-parsing.md, section '#### Environment / Version' quotes the content verbatim: '> Not sure which version — using whatever is deployed on staging.' The section table also marks the heading '### **Environment / Version**' as 'Yes (present, but it contains no version identifier)', and the notes say 'The content is vague. It has no explicit version number...'

assertion_results.text: Version resolution determines that no version identifier can be extracted from the vague description (Step 4.5.2)
assertion_results.evidence: version-resolution.md, '## 4.5.2 – Extract version from description' checks three patterns (explicit number, product-prefixed, version keyword + number), all 'No', and concludes: 'Classification: **vague / unknown**' and '**Result: no version identifier could be extracted.**' It then skips 4.5.3-4.5.5 and goes to 4.5.6.

assertion_results.text: Version resolution outputs the gap comment: 'Affects Version could not be determined from the bug description — please set manually.' (Step 4.5.6)
assertion_results.evidence: version-resolution.md, '## 4.5.6 – Flag gap' shows jira.add_comment("ACME-511", ...) with an ADF text node that reads exactly: "Affects Version could not be determined from the bug description — please set manually."

assertion_results.text: The gap comment includes the Comment Footnote (Step 4.5.6)
assertion_results.evidence: The ADF gap comment in version-resolution.md ends with { "type": "rule" } followed by a paragraph: 'This comment was AI-generated by ' + 'sdlc-workflow/triage-bug' (link mark href https://github.com/RHEcosystemAppEng/sdlc-plugins) + ' v0.13.10.'. This matches the Comment Footnote in triage-bug/SKILL.md lines 64-106 (a rule node plus an attribution paragraph, appended at the end of content), and the version matches plugin.json version 0.13.10.
